bullets.section: What I’m reading and sharing with friends —
bullets.title: Coronavirus: Why You Must Act Now
bullets.creator: Tomas Pueyo
bullets.note:
fourhourmail.com/c/e5ux264rrb7hqonnmsz/62heh8hd6x0ggp/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90b21hc3B1ZXlv)). This is probably the best write-up I’ve found thus far on what needs to be done and why. It also includes case studies and suggestions. Many thanks to Chris G. for sending it my way. Here is one snippet:  
  
_This chart shows, for the 1918 flu in the US, how many more deaths there were per city depending on how fast measures were taken. For example, a city like St. Louis took measures 6 days before Pittsburg, and had less than half the deaths per citizen. On average, taking measures 20 days earlier halved the death rate._

_Italy has finally figured this out. They first locked down Lombardy on Sunday, and one day later, on Monday, they realized their mistake and decided they had to lock down the entire country._

_Hopefully, we will see results in the coming days. However, it will take one to two weeks to see. Remember the Wuhan graph: there was a delay of 12 days between the moment when the lockdown was announced and the moment when official cases (orange) started going down._
